## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: speed, passing, right-of-way, intersections, highways and turns
Knowledge facts: part C holds 45 fact blocks (sec06-F01 onward) from physical pages 64 to 75; part C2 holds 24 confusable and continuation blocks (sec06-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 manual, the 50-question count and the 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical pages 32 and 33; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NJ-ROAD-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NJ-ROAD-D-LIMITS — pairing of each default speed limit with its road type in the limit graphic (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- NJ-ROAD-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-ROAD-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the Safe Corridor highway list, fines and penalties (for example sec06-F15, sec06-F26) can change and must be refreshed from the New Jersey Department of Transportation and MVC websites.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
